FN-LMR9YAW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 364
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Leigh Hulsey
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/16/2024
House Bill 364 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of each local board
of education to: (1) adopt polices on internet safety; (2) provide instruction on the effects of
social media for students in grades 6 through 12; and (3) inform parents of the availability of the
instructional material.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the State Department of
Education to publish instructional material on its website pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-LMR9YAW-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 364
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Leigh Hulsey
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/17/2024
House Bill 364 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the
administrative obligations of each local board of education to: (1) adopt polices on internet
safety; (2) provide instruction on the effects of social media for students in grades 6 through 12;
and (3) update, develop, and/or implement a cell phone policy for students during instructional
hours.
